mentions.name: Sun signal
mentions.description: This app helps users time their life events with the sun, optimizing work, sleep, and rest schedules by following sunrise, solar noon, and sunset.
mentions.problem: Counters burnout and the culture of working (e.g., AI vibe coding) all night long.
mentions.source_excerpt: Sun signal. You can time your life events with the sun: think optimize work time, sleep time, rest time by following sunrise, solar noon and sunset.

mentions.name: Sun Signal
mentions.description: Sun Signal is a web app that provides a simple signal for the sun in any US zip code, letting users quickly and intuitively see the sun through their day, week, and month and plan around sun events.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Sun Signal. A simple signal for the sun in your zip code, USA only now though happy to expedite your area if you want, it lets you quickly intuitive the sun through your day, week and month and plan around sun events.

https://sunsignal.app
